description: HypoSense Twin v2 canonical feature specification (generated from src/hyposense/features/spec.py; do not edit by hand)

features.name: cgm
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: g(t), the reading at t

features.name: cgm_lag15
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: value of the reading nearest to t - 15 min within +/- lag_tolerance_min (7.5 min); ties go to the earlier reading

features.name: cgm_lag30
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: value of the reading nearest to t - 30 min within +/- lag_tolerance_min (7.5 min); ties go to the earlier reading

features.name: cgm_lag45
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: value of the reading nearest to t - 45 min within +/- lag_tolerance_min (7.5 min); ties go to the earlier reading

features.name: cgm_lag60
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: value of the reading nearest to t - 60 min within +/- lag_tolerance_min (7.5 min); ties go to the earlier reading

features.name: cgm_m0_proj30
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: M0 trend projection g(t) + 30 x cgm_slope30 (executable spec audit2.py: least-squares slope over (t - 35 min, t], >= 3 readings)

features.name: cgm_m0_proj60
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: M0 trend projection g(t) + 60 x cgm_slope30 (executable spec audit2.py: least-squares slope over (t - 35 min, t], >= 3 readings)

features.name: cgm_lag15_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if no reading within 7.5 min of t - 15, else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: cgm_lag30_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if no reading within 7.5 min of t - 30, else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: cgm_lag45_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if no reading within 7.5 min of t - 45, else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: cgm_lag60_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if no reading within 7.5 min of t - 60, else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: cgm_slope30
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: least-squares slope of g on time over (t - 30 - 5 min, t] (trend_window_tolerance_min = 5, the M0 window convention); exact sums

features.name: cgm_slope60
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: least-squares slope of g on time over (t - 60 - 5 min, t] (trend_window_tolerance_min = 5, the M0 window convention); exact sums

features.name: cgm_slope120
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: least-squares slope of g on time over (t - 120 - 5 min, t] (trend_window_tolerance_min = 5, the M0 window convention); exact sums

features.name: cgm_accel
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: cgm_slope30 - cgm_slope60 (App. D: 'slope 30 - slope 60')

features.name: cgm_n_falling
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: number of consecutive strictly falling steps ending at t; a step longer than event.max_step_min (20 min) ends the run
features.zero_meaning: g(t) is not below the previous reading

features.name: cgm_slope30_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if < 3 readings in (t - 35 min, t], else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: cgm_slope60_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if < 3 readings in (t - 65 min, t], else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: cgm_min_2h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: minimum of readings in (t - 120 min, t]; a recording younger than the window uses the readings it has

features.name: cgm_mean_2h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: mean (exact sum) of readings in (t - 120 min, t]; a recording younger than the window uses the readings it has

features.name: cgm_sd_2h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) of readings in (t - 120 min, t]; a recording younger than the window uses the readings it has

features.name: cgm_min_6h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: minimum of readings in (t - 360 min, t]; a recording younger than the window uses the readings it has

features.name: cgm_mean_6h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: mean (exact sum) of readings in (t - 360 min, t]; a recording younger than the window uses the readings it has

features.name: cgm_sd_6h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) of readings in (t - 360 min, t]; a recording younger than the window uses the readings it has

features.name: cgm_min_24h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: minimum of readings in (t - 1440 min, t]; a recording younger than the window uses the readings it has

features.name: cgm_mean_24h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: mean (exact sum) of readings in (t - 1440 min, t]; a recording younger than the window uses the readings it has

features.name: cgm_sd_24h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) of readings in (t - 1440 min, t]; a recording younger than the window uses the readings it has

features.name: cgm_cv_24h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: cgm_sd_24h / cgm_mean_24h

features.name: cgm_min_below80_24h
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: 15 (nominal sampling interval) x number of readings < 80 mg/dL in (t - 24 h, t]
features.zero_meaning: no reading < 80 mg/dL in the past 24 h

features.name: cgm_prior_l1_onsets
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t (causal episode tracker, state.cgm)
features.computation: L1 onsets in this recording confirmed at or before t (onset at reading i is confirmed by reading i+1; same rule as the label builder)
features.zero_meaning: no confirmed L1 onset in the recording so far

features.name: cgm_min_since_low70
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: minutes since the latest reading < 70 mg/dL, capped at 1440
features.nan_meaning: NOT_OBSERVED (no reading < 70 in the recording so far)

features.name: cgm_pct_own
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: mid-rank percentile of g(t) among all readings of the recording up to t: 100 x (#{g < g(t)} + 0.5 #{g = g(t)}) / n

features.name: sensor_day
features.source: CGM readings of this recording with ts <= t
features.computation: floor((t - first reading of the recording) / 24 h) + 1

features.name: cgm_min_since_low70_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if no reading < 70 so far, else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: cgm_pct_own_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if t - first reading < 24 h, else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: hour_sin
features.source: local clock (+08:00, ASSUMPTION) of t
features.computation: sin(2 pi h / 24), h = hour of day

features.name: hour_cos
features.source: local clock (+08:00, ASSUMPTION) of t
features.computation: cos(2 pi h / 24)

features.name: night
features.source: local clock (+08:00, ASSUMPTION) of t
features.computation: 1 if 00:00 <= local time < 06:00

features.name: act_prandial
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: sum dose x weight x a(t - t_i), rapid + regular components incl. premix fast fractions and CSII micro-boluses
features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code)
features.zero_meaning: no exposure of this class at t

features.name: act_intermediate
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: the same for NPH components
features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code)
features.zero_meaning: no exposure of this class at t

features.name: act_basal
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: the same for basal analogues (flat kernels)
features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code)
features.zero_meaning: no exposure of this class at t

features.name: act_insulin_total

features.name: iob_insulin
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)

features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code)
features.zero_meaning: no exposure of this class at t

features.zero_meaning: no exposure of this class at t

features.name: act_glinide
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: as act_su, for glinides
features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code)
features.zero_meaning: no exposure of this class at t

features.name: glinide_p30
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: act_glinide at t + 30 from doses <= t
features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code)
features.zero_meaning: no exposure of this class at t

features.name: glinide_p60
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: act_glinide at t + 60 from doses <= t
features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code)
features.zero_meaning: no exposure of this class at t

features.name: min_since_insulin
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: minutes since the latest insulin administration, capped at 1440

features.name: min_since_su
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: minutes since the latest sulfonylurea administration, capped at 1440

features.name: min_since_glinide
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: minutes since the latest glinide administration, capped at 1440

features.name: delta_insulin_60
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: insulin_p60 - act_insulin_total (App. D 'Delta exposure next 60 min')
features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code)

features.name: delta_su_60
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: su_p60 - act_su
features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code)

features.name: act_insulin_total_per_kg
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml); summary weight
features.computation: act_insulin_total / weight_kg (§12.2: 'per kg body weight when weight is known')
features.availability: administrations up to t; static weight
features.nan_meaning: TIMING_UNKNOWN / DOSE_UNKNOWN / FORMULATION_UNKNOWN for the class (quality code); or weight unknown

features.name: quality_insulin
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: QualityState code: 0 KNOWN, 1 PARTIAL, 2 TIMING_UNKNOWN, 3 DOSE_UNKNOWN, 4 FORMULATION_UNKNOWN, 5 NO_LOGGED_MEDICATION (the 'timing-unknown indicators' of App. D)
features.availability: administrations and regimen up to t

features.name: quality_sulfonylurea
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: QualityState code: 0 KNOWN, 1 PARTIAL, 2 TIMING_UNKNOWN, 3 DOSE_UNKNOWN, 4 FORMULATION_UNKNOWN, 5 NO_LOGGED_MEDICATION (the 'timing-unknown indicators' of App. D)
features.availability: administrations and regimen up to t

features.name: quality_glinide
features.source: parsed medication events with ts <= t (ExposureEngine, configs/pharma.yaml)
features.computation: QualityState code: 0 KNOWN, 1 PARTIAL, 2 TIMING_UNKNOWN, 3 DOSE_UNKNOWN, 4 FORMULATION_UNKNOWN, 5 NO_LOGGED_MEDICATION (the 'timing-unknown indicators' of App. D)
features.availability: administrations and regimen up to t

features.name: min_since_insulin_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if no insulin administration logged before t, else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: min_since_su_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if no sulfonylurea administration logged before t, else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates

features.name: min_since_glinide_missing
features.source: indicator
features.computation: 1 if no glinide administration logged before t, else 0
features.availability: same information as the features it indicates
